mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_pass (student_id, center_code, product_id, service_code, source, ref_no, billing_ym, total_count, remain_count, granted_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{centerCode}, #{productId}, #{serviceCode}, #{source}, #{refNo}, #{billingYm}, #{totalCount}, #{totalCount}, DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()))
mapper.sql: pass_id, student_id, center_code, product_id, service_code, source, ref_no, billing_ym, total_count, remain_count, granted_at, revoked_at
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 FROM erp_bookstore_pass WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND service_code = #{serviceCode} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND remain_count > 0 ORDER BY granted_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_pass SET remain_count = remain_count - 1 WHERE pass_id = #{passId} AND remain_count > 0 AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_pass_use (pass_id, student_id, session_id, used_date, created_at) VALUES (#{passId}, #{studentId}, #{sessionId}, #{usedDate}, DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()))
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_pass SET remain_count = 0, revoked_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE pass_id = #{passId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
